lead_raw_text:
The structure of Zr₂Mg₁₀Pb₂ (reduced formula ZrMg₅Pb) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 14 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows all Mg, Pb, and Zr centers adopt close-packed-like local arrangements with 12 geometric neighbors; the Mg environments vary, with neighbor counts spanning 5–11 Mg, 2–5 Zr, and 2–5 Pb atoms, while Pb and Zr each have 12 Mg neighbors. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies Mg–Mg and Mg–Pb 12-vertex coordination polyhedra connected through corner, edge, and face contacts, forming a three-dimensional periodic connectivity network.
